_comment: No single entry loads both `lib-shell` and `lib-a`, so without load roots no merge saves a request. The load root `main.js` + `page-a.js` downloads both, and merging them saves it one request for 94 added bytes (`lib-a` added to `main` and `admin`, `lib-shell` added to `page-a` and `page-c`), within the budget of 100. `lib-b` stays in the chunk of `page-b`, the only entry that loads it. `admin` loads `lib-shell` and `page-c` loads `lib-a` so that neither is a module only one entry loads, which would stay in that entry's chunk.
